v1.2.0.name: Bloodborne PC Vulkan v1.2.0
v1.2.0.body:
## Bloodborne PC Vulkan v1.2.0 (Windows & Linux)

**Quick Start:** Extract next to your `CUSA03173` (`v1.09`) folder and run **`Bloodborne.exe`** / **`Launcher.exe`** (Windows) or **`./play.sh`** / **`./launcher.sh`** (Linux).

### What's New
- **Massive CPU & High-FPS Boost (+35–55% Faster in Heavy Areas)** — Overhauled every major CPU bottleneck across the entire rendering pipeline: the DirectVk RHI stage, Vulkan command recording, pipeline lookup, light/VFX batchers, and Bloodborne's multi-threaded scene worker pool. Central Yharnam now runs **330–375+ FPS** at native `1440p` (and **500+ FPS** in lighter views) on high-end hardware, pushing even an RTX 4090 into GPU-bound territory.
- **Faster Multi-Core Scene Workers & Lower CPU Heat** — Replaced legacy kernel semaphore wakeups on Bloodborne's 6 graphics worker threads with an ultra-fast user-space wakeup coordinator, balanced work distribution across all workers, and inlined the hot C++20 shader/vertex binding loops — cutting worker thread overhead and frame-time spikes significantly.
- **Upgraded `F9` Performance X-Ray Overlay** — Added a live 5-line breakdown of Bloodborne's main game-engine CPU thread (`1a. Scene Draw`, `1b. World/AI`, `1c. Physics/Cloth`, `1d. UI/Input`, `1e. Other`) alongside `Stage A`, `Stage B`, and GPU passes so you can instantly see what drives your frame time.

v1.1.9.name: Bloodborne PC Vulkan v1.1.9
v1.1.9.body:
## Bloodborne PC Vulkan v1.1.9 (Windows & Linux)

**Quick Start:** Extract next to your `CUSA03173` (`v1.09`) folder and run **`Bloodborne.exe`** / **`Launcher.exe`** (Windows) or **`./play.sh`** / **`./launcher.sh`** (Linux).

### What's New
- **Authentic Native Launcher Overhaul** — Redesigned the launcher with a clean dark-slate glass look and zero startup flicker. Instead of shipping any copyrighted assets, it decodes the official Bloodborne title artwork, Victorian game font (with full Cyrillic support), and ambient music (*Hunter's Dream* & *Omen*) straight from your own game files on first run — so the launcher feels like an official native companion app.
- **Seamless Game Boot Splash** — Launching the game now opens straight into Bloodborne's authentic title artwork and hands off cleanly to the main menu with no black-screen flash.
- **Fixed Cathedral Ward & Oedon Chapel Crash** — Fixed a reproducible multi-thread crash that happened when entering Cathedral Ward / boss areas.
- **Fixed Pink/Blue Window Glow** — Corrected an RGB/BGR color inversion bug on glowing gothic windows and bloom passes so Yharnam's sunset light stays warm amber as intended.
- **Fixed Crash When Toggling Graphics Effects Live** — Switching Bloom, DoF, SSAO, or SSR on/off in-game no longer risks crashing.
- **Live In-Game VSync (`Fast / On / Off`)** — Switch VSync modes on the fly in `System -> Display` without restarting.
- **Faster Game Startup** — Skips redundant binary prep on repeat launches, cutting ~2.3 seconds off every boot.
- **Better Crash Reports & 1-Click Auto-Updater Fix** — Crash logs (`logs/crash-*.log`) are never left empty on multi-thread crashes, and the built-in 1-click updater works reliably again.

## Bloodborne PC Vulkan v1.1.8 (Windows & Linux)

### What's New
- **Single-Process Native Launch (Zero Python in RAM)** — Renamed the game executable cleanly to **`Bloodborne.exe`** (Windows) and **`bb-vulkan`** (Linux) and replaced the Windows Python wrapper with a tiny native C++ starter. During gameplay only the game itself stays in memory, keeping the root folder spotless.
- **Native Taskbar Icons (Windows & Linux Wayland)** — Both the launcher and the game now show the proper **Hunter's Mark** icon in Windows Taskbar and Linux Wayland docks instead of a generic placeholder.

### What's New
- **Brand-New Native C++ Launcher** — Replaced the old heavy Python/GTK/WPF launchers with an instant-start native WebView launcher focused only on what you need before playing: Play, Mods & Patches, Online, Shader Pre-Bake, and a guided First-Time Setup.
- **Authentic Bloodborne Menu Sounds** — Decodes the original UI hover, click, and confirm sounds directly from your local game files (no copyrighted audio bundled) with subtle gothic stone-chamber reverb.
- **Cleaner Windows Packaging** — Removed leftover helper executables and refreshed Windows Explorer icons automatically after 1-click updates.

v1.1.6.name: Bloodborne PC Vulkan v1.1.6
v1.1.6.body:
## Bloodborne PC Vulkan v1.1.6 (Windows & Linux)

**Quick Start:** Extract next to your `CUSA03173` (`v1.09`) folder and run **`Bloodborne.exe`** / **`Launcher.exe`** (Windows) or **`./play.sh`** / **`./launcher.sh`** (Linux).

### What's New
- **Complete Full-Game Shader Pre-Bake (`5,761` Shaders)** — Expanded the pre-baker to cover every shader archive plus all shaders embedded inside `eboot.bin`. Pre-bake once in the launcher (or let the quiet background auto-baker finish while you play) so you don't get shader-compile stutters during gameplay.
- **Zero-Pop-In Async Shader Compilation** — Eliminated multi-second stalls and invisible armor/character pop-in on first combat hits when a rare shader variant compiles on the fly.
- **Fixed Missing Blood Splatter on Hunter's Clothes & Face** — Restored dynamic blood splatter on your attire, cape, and face after combat kills on modern desktop GPUs.
- **Free Extra FPS & Stability** — Added front-to-back G-Buffer sorting, faster resource resolution, more native Vulkan shaders (`129` total), a Windows cold-start fix, and an automatic frame-spike log (`logs/bb_hitch.log`).

v1.1.5.name: Bloodborne PC Vulkan v1.1.5
v1.1.5.body:
## Bloodborne PC Vulkan v1.1.5 (Windows & Linux)

**Quick Start:** Extract next to your `CUSA03173` (`v1.09`) folder and run **`Bloodborne.exe`** / **`Launcher.exe`** (Windows) or **`./play.sh`** / **`./launcher.sh`** (Linux).

### What's New
- **Shader Pre-Baker & Quiet Background Auto-Baker** — Pre-compiles game shaders ahead of time (with a `0% -> 100%` progress bar in the launcher) to eliminate gameplay stutters.
- **Silky-Smooth Frame Pacing & `1000+ Hz` Mouse Input** — Overhauled frame pacing and switched mouse input to event-driven polling. Moving the camera while playing feels noticeably smoother with almost zero frame-time jitter.
- **New `Balanced` Smooth Camera (`F4` Live Switch)** — Inspired by *Lies of P*'s smooth camera feel, refined specifically for Bloodborne so strafing, sprinting, and climbing stairs feel fluid without harsh camera jerks. Switch live anytime between `Original (PS4)`, `Balanced`, and `Locked (1:1)`.
- **4–5× Faster Location & Respawn Loading** — Accelerated decompression and loading-screen pacing so warping and respawning take ~2–3 seconds instead of 11–12.
- **Expanded In-Game Menus & Scrollbars** — Redesigned the in-game `System` menu with comfortable gothic scrollbars, instant mouse-wheel scrolling, `Exit Game` right on the Title Screen, and instant saving of all settings.
- **1-Click Auto-Updater & Crash Black-Box** — Update directly from the launcher with SHA-256 verification, and get automatic crash reports (`logs/crash-*.log`) if anything ever goes wrong.

v1.1.4.name: Bloodborne PC Vulkan v1.1.4
v1.1.4.body:
## Bloodborne PC Vulkan v1.1.4 (Windows & Linux)

**Quick Start:** Extract next to your `CUSA03173` (`v1.09`) folder and run **`Bloodborne.exe`** / **`Launcher.exe`** (Windows) or **`./play.sh`** / **`./launcher.sh`** (Linux).

### What's New
- **30–50% Higher CPU-Bound FPS in Heavy Areas** — Rebuilt the internal GPU command path to strip out legacy translation overhead, giving much higher frame rates in dense scenes like Central Yharnam.
- **Smarter 3D Occlusion Culling** — Skips up to 41% of hidden world geometry and 45% of enemies behind walls before they ever hit the GPU.
- **123 Native Vulkan Shaders** — Rewrote 10 more heavy shaders (foliage, shadows, fog, bloom/post-FX) into clean native Vulkan shaders for lower GPU load and fewer frame-time spikes.

v1.1.3.name: Bloodborne PC Vulkan v1.1.3
v1.1.3.body:
## Bloodborne PC Vulkan v1.1.3 (Windows & Linux)

**Quick Start:** Extract next to your `CUSA03173` (`v1.09`) folder and run **`Bloodborne.exe`** / **`Launcher.exe`** (Windows) or **`./play.sh`** / **`./launcher.sh`** (Linux).

### What's New
- **Draw-Call Batching & Smarter Caching** — Merged repetitive light tiles, UI quads, and particle draws, and skipped redundant shadow/velocity work for stationary objects — cutting draw calls by up to 40% in heavily lit areas.
- **Fixed Long-Session Slowdowns** — Eliminated gradual CPU frame-rate drops that used to build up after exploring multiple zones in one session.
- **Fixed Missing Player Shadow & Cascade Seam** — Turning off `Dynamic Shadows` no longer removes your character's sun/moon shadow.

v1.1.2.name: Bloodborne PC Vulkan v1.1.2
v1.1.2.body:
## Bloodborne PC Vulkan v1.1.2 (Windows & Linux)

**Quick Start:** Extract next to your `CUSA03173` (`v1.09`) folder and run **`Bloodborne.exe`** / **`Launcher.exe`** (Windows) or **`./play.sh`** / **`./launcher.sh`** (Linux).

### What's New
- **Better Multi-Core CPU Threading** — Kept the main rendering threads together on dedicated physical cores in the same CPU cache domain for steadier frame times and lower latency.
- **Smarter Motion Blur** — Automatically skips unnecessary motion-blur work when both the camera and characters are standing still.
- **More Accurate Performance Overlay (`F8` / `F9`)** — Now shows exact per-process VRAM usage and separates real GPU work from idle wait time.

v1.1.1.body:
## Bloodborne PC Vulkan v1.1.1 (Windows & Linux)

**Quick Start:** Extract next to your `CUSA03173` (`v1.09`) folder and run **`Bloodborne.exe`** / **`Launcher.exe`** (Windows) or **`./play.sh`** / **`./launcher.sh`** (Linux).

### What's New
- **Windows Performance Parity** — Fixed hardware occlusion culling on Windows and ported the remaining Linux optimizations so Windows runs on par with Linux.
- **Fixed Live Graphics Toggles** — `SSAO`, `SSR`, and `Depth of Field` now turn on and off reliably right inside `System -> Effects`.
- **Fixed High-FPS Grass & Foliage Wind** — Grass, bushes, and flowers now sway at normal speed at 60–300+ FPS instead of shaking hyper-fast.
- **Automatic Split Patch Folder Support** — Automatically detects split `CUSAxxxxx` + `CUSAxxxxx-patch` folders with no manual merging needed.
- **Rebindable Debug Hotkeys** — Added `Debug` (`F8`) and `Additional Debug` (`F9`) to in-game `System -> Controls`.

v1.1.0.name: Bloodborne PC Vulkan v1.1.0
v1.1.0.body:
## Bloodborne PC Vulkan v1.1.0 (Windows & Linux)

**Quick Start:** Extract next to your `CUSA03173` (`v1.09`) folder and run **`Bloodborne.exe`** / **`Launcher.exe`** (Windows) or **`./play.sh`** / **`./launcher.sh`** (Linux).

### What's New
- **Native Windows 10/11 Support** — First full prebuilt Windows release with the entire refactored C++20 graphics engine and zero page-fault VRAM handling.
- **Huge Performance Boost** — Rewrote 109 core shaders into clean Vulkan shaders and added hardware occlusion culling, dramatically boosting FPS at 1440p and 4K.
- **7 Anti-Aliasing Modes & Zero-Cost Sharpening** — Added `DLAA 4`, `DLAA 3`, `SMAA T2x`, `SMAA 1x Ultra`, plus free `RCAS` sharpening baked straight into final output.
- **Live Window Modes** — Switch cleanly between `Fullscreen`, `Borderless`, and `Windowed` (`Alt+Enter`) on the fly.

v1.0.0.name: Bloodborne PC Vulkan v1.0.0
v1.0.0.body:
## Bloodborne PC Vulkan v1.0.0 (Linux Initial Prebuilt Release)

**Quick Start:** Extract next to your `CUSA03173` (`v1.09`) folder and run **`./play.sh`** (or **`./launcher.sh`**).

### Highlights
- **Refactored Native C++20 Graphics Engine** — Replaced the heavy PS4 rendering bottleneck with native C++20 and Vulkan 1.3 split VRAM, drastically cutting RAM/VRAM usage and unlocking true uncapped FPS.
- **Full In-Game PC Menu & Controls Refactor** — Rebind any keyboard & mouse control (including mouse wheel and alternate keys) and change graphics, resolution, upscalers, and effects live right inside Bloodborne's own `System` menu — no external launcher restart required.
- **Modern Upscalers & Optional Remaster Visuals** — Live support for `DLSS 4.5` / `DLSS 4` / `DLAA` / `FSR 3.1 & 4`, `2×/4×` GPU UI & icon upscaling, fixed dark foliage undersides, and 4 optional remaster toggles (`GTAO/SSAO`, `Contact Shadows`, `Adaptive SSR`, and `True Black / OLED`).
